{{- /* An API reference symbol's page body with its folded members as sections, grouped by kind (api-member-groups.html: "Property details", "Method details", ...). Each member is a `
` (main.css.tmpl: a rule and room above, so one entry ends visibly before the next) under an `

` anchored by api-member-anchor.html: the owner muted, the member's own name strong (api-member-name.html), then its kind and stability as pills. The member's own headings go two levels down and their ids get the member's as a prefix (every member has a "Remarks"). api-documenter's "Signature:" paragraph is dropped: the declaration's code block speaks for itself. Its "Returns:" paragraph becomes a small label that sits on the block it names. A link to one of these members, in the symbol's own content or a member's, is an in-page link to its section. Expects: the symbol's page. Returns the HTML string: the body (without api-documenter's h1) and the member sections. */ -}} {{- $out := replaceRE `]*>.*?

\n?` "" (string .Content) 1 -}} {{- range partial "api-member-groups.html" . -}} {{- $out = printf "%s\n

%s

" $out .id .title -}} {{- range .members -}} {{- $id := anchorize .Title -}} {{- $name := partial "api-member-name.html" . -}} {{- $pills := "" -}} {{- with .Params.kind }}{{ $pills = printf `%s%s` $pills . }}{{ end -}} {{- with .Params.stability }}{{ $pills = printf `%s%s` $pills . (strings.FirstUpper .) }}{{ end -}} {{- if .Params.deprecated }}{{ $pills = printf `%sDeprecated` $pills }}{{ end -}} {{- $body := replaceRE `]*>.*?\n?` "" (string .Content) 1 -}} {{- range slice 4 3 2 -}} {{- $body = replaceRE (printf `<(/?)h%d\b` .) (printf "<${1}h%d" (add . 2)) $body -}} {{- end -}} {{- $body = replaceRE ` id="([^"]+)"` (printf ` id="%s-${1}"` $id) $body -}} {{- $out = printf "%s\n
\n

%s%s%s

\n%s\n
" $out $id ($name.owner | htmlEscape) ($name.name | htmlEscape) $pills $body -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- $out = replaceRE `

Signature:

\n?` "" $out -}} {{- $out = replaceRE `

Returns:

` `

Returns

` $out -}} {{- $out = replaceRE `(?s)\n?` "" $out -}} {{- /* Member links go to `#` (api-member-links.html); on this page that is an in-page link. */ -}} {{- $out = partial "api-member-links.html" $out -}} {{- $out = replace $out (printf `href="%s#` .RelPermalink) `href="#` -}} {{- return $out -}}
